False), (\"e25\", True), (\"e30\", False)\n]\n\ndef pois(lam, k):\n    return math.exp(-lam) * (lam ** k) / math.factorial(k)\n\nfor extra_frame in [0.0, 1.0/38.0]:\n    lam_ah_inn = 0.1 + 1.0/38.0 + print(f\"=== extra_frame = {extra_frame:.4f} ===\")\n    for emp, (w, ah, reg, ev, nev) in sorted(weights.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1][0]):\n        print(f\"  {emp}: P={w/Z:.4f}  (AH={ah}, reg={reg},
